The weighted cloud reliability calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect reward score, demonstrating a robust implementation of the risk logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.84 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.30s. While the core logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge case handling for zero-weight inputs to maintain the 1.0 mean reward.
